title: Edmund and the Bridge
author: Sable Villalobos
blurb: Odile Brightwater, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
